parsed.name: Ark Metrica步进电机线性位移控制器
parsed.name_en: Ark Metrica Stepper Motor Linear Motion Controller
parsed.description: 用于控制步进电机驱动的线性位移机构或位移台。该设备通过串口/VISA通信，支持连接识别、速度与加速度设置、回零、按目标位置移动、位置读取以及急停，适合实验中的样品或探头直线定位任务。
parsed.description_en: A stepper-motor-based linear motion controller for a linear actuator or positioning stage. It communicates over serial/VISA and supports device identification, speed and acceleration settings, homing, moving to a target position, position readback, and emergency stop for laboratory sample or probe positioning tasks.
